turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.

Hale. I have a call at 4:40, so we have twenty minutes. My son found out he had a zero from his phone, in the middle of a class, before anyone in this building picked up a phone to call me. Who decided that, and on what basis?
We're out of time? I walked in two minutes ago and I'm not leaving until you answer my question. Who decided on the zero, and was Owen heard before it went into the gradebook?
Just say okay and I'll write it up as resolved. Okay?
No. Nothing is resolved until that zero comes off and I have it in writing. Who decided, Hale?
No. If you won't answer me, I'm going to the principal's office from here. Your choice, Hale.
Ms. Kalinowski. I need you to say okay.
"I need you to say okay." I'm writing that down, next to the zero you entered without calling me. The answer is still no.
